# Hosea Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 330v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HOS_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-word of-YHWH which came [hayah] to Hoshe'a [Hosea] son of-Be'eri [Beeri] in-the-days of-Uzziyyah [Uzziah], Yotam [Jotham], Achaz [Ahaz], Chizkiyyah [Hezekiah], kings of-Yehudah, and-in-the-days of-Yarov'am [Jeroboam] son of-Yo'ash [Joash], king of-Yisra'el.

**1:2** The-beginning [techillat] of-the-speaking [dibber] of-YHWH through-Hoshe'a. And-said YHWH to Hoshe'a, "Go [lekh], take [qach] for-yourself a-wife [eshet] of-harlotry [zenunim] and-children [yaldei] of-harlotry; for the-land [ha-arets] goes-whoring [zanoh tizneh] away from YHWH."

**1:3** And-he-went [vayyeelekh] and-took [vayyiqqach] Gomer [Gomer] daughter of-Divlayim [Diblaim]; and-she-conceived [vattahar] and-bore [vatteled] to-him a-son.

**1:4** And-said YHWH to-him, "Call [qera] his-name [shemo] Yizre'el [Jezreel]; for yet a-little [me'at] and-I-will-visit [ufaqadeti] the-blood [demei] of-Yizre'el upon the-house of-Yehu [Jehu], and-I-will-bring-to-an-end [vehishbatti] the-kingdom [mamlekhet] of-the-house of-Yisra'el."

**1:6** And-she-conceived again [od] and-bore a-daughter. And-he-said to-him, "Call her-name Lo-Ruchamah [Not-Pitied]; for I-will-not again [lo osif od] have-pity [arachem] on-the-house of-Yisra'el, that I-should-ever forgive [ki nasa essa] them."

**1:8** And-she-weaned [vattigmol] Lo-Ruchamah, and-she-conceived and-bore a-son. **1:9** And-he-said, "Call his-name Lo-Ammi [Not-My-People]; for you [are] not my-people [ammi] and-I [am] not [your] I-AM [ehyeh] for-you."

**1:10** Yet the-number of-the-sons of-Yisra'el will-be [vehayah] like-the-sand [ke-chol] of-the-sea [ha-yam] which cannot [lo] be-measured [yimmad] and-cannot be-counted [yissafer]; and-it-will-be in-the-place [bi-meqom] where it-was-said to-them, "You [are] not my-people [lo-ammi]," it-will-be-said to-them, "Sons of-the-living God [benei El-chai]."

**1:11** And-the-sons of-Yehudah and-the-sons of-Yisra'el will-be-gathered [veniqqbetsu] together [yachdav] and-appoint [vesamu] for-themselves one [echad] head [rosh], and-they-will-go-up [ve'alu] from-the-land; for great [gadol] [is] the-day of-Yizre'el.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "wife of harlotry":** *Eshet zenunim* — whether Gomer was already a prostitute or this is a prophetic characterization is the most debated question in Hosea scholarship. The marriage is an enacted parable of YHWH and Israel.

**v.4 — "Jezreel":** The name means "God sows/scatters" — both judgment (scattering) and hope (planting). The Valley of Jezreel was where Jehu massacred the house of Ahab (2 Kings 9-10).

**v.9 — "Lo-Ammi... I am not your I-AM":** The Hebrew *lo ehyeh lakhem* echoes Exodus 3:14 ("I AM WHO I AM"). God un-names himself to Israel — the covenant formula is reversed.

*— EMET*
